verses.original: Πέτρος ἀπόστολος Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ Ἐκλεκτοῖς παρεπιδήμοις Διασπορᾶς Πόντου Γαλατίας Καππαδοκίας Ἀσίας καὶ Βιθυνίας
verses.transliteration: Petros apostolos Iēsou Christou Eklektois parepidēmois Diasporas Pontou Galatias Kappadokias Asias kai Bithynias
verses.literal: Peter an apostle of Jesus Christ To the elect who are exiles of the Dispersion throughout Pontus Galatia Cappadocia Asia and Bithynia, chosen
verses.literalPt: PEDRO, apóstolo de Jesus Cristo, aos estrangeiros dispersos no Ponto, Galácia, Capadócia, Ásia e Bitínia;

verses.original: κατὰ πρόγνωσιν Θεοῦ Πατρός ἐν ἁγιασμῷ Πνεύματος εἰς ὑπακοὴν καὶ ῥαντισμὸν αἵματος Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ Χάρις ὑμῖν καὶ εἰρήνη πληθυνθείη
verses.transliteration: kata prognōsin Theou Patros en hagiasmō Pneumatos eis hypakoēn kai rhantismon haimatos Iēsou Christou Charis hymin kai eirēnē plēthyntheiē
verses.literal: according to the foreknowledge of God the Father and sanctified by the Spirit for obedience to Jesus Christ and sprinkling by His blood Grace and peace be yours in abundance
verses.literalPt: Eleitos segundo a presciência de Deus Pai, em santificação do Espírito, para a obediência e aspersão do sangue de Jesus Cristo: Graça e paz vos sejam multiplicadas.

verses.original: Εὐλογητὸς ὁ Θεὸς καὶ Πατὴρ τοῦ Κυρίου ἡμῶν Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ ὁ κατὰ τὸ πολὺ αὐτοῦ ἔλεος ἀναγεννήσας ἡμᾶς εἰς ἐλπίδα ζῶσαν δι’ ἀναστάσεως Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ ἐκ νεκρῶν
verses.transliteration: Eulogētos ho Theos kai Patēr tou Kyriou hēmōn Iēsou Christou ho kata to poly autou eleos anagennēsas hēmas eis elpida zōsan di’ anastaseōs Iēsou Christou ek nekrōn
verses.literal: Blessed be the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ By His great mercy He has given us new birth into a living hope through the resurrection of Jesus Christ from the dead
verses.literalPt: Bendito seja o Deus e Pai de nosso Senhor Jesus Cristo que, segundo a sua grande misericórdia, nos gerou de novo para uma viva esperança, pela ressurreição de Jesus Cristo dentre os mortos,

verses.original: εἰς κληρονομίαν ἄφθαρτον καὶ ἀμίαντον καὶ ἀμάραντον τετηρημένην ἐν οὐρανοῖς εἰς ὑμᾶς
verses.transliteration: eis klēronomian aphtharton kai amianton kai amaranton tetērēmenēn en ouranois eis hymas
verses.literal: and into an inheritance that is imperishable undefiled and unfading reserved in heaven for you
verses.literalPt: Para uma herança incorruptível, incontaminável, e que não se pode murchar, guardada nos céus para vós,

verses.original: τοὺς ἐν δυνάμει Θεοῦ φρουρουμένους διὰ πίστεως εἰς σωτηρίαν ἑτοίμην ἀποκαλυφθῆναι ἐν καιρῷ ἐσχάτῳ
verses.transliteration: tous en dynamei Theou phrouroumenous dia pisteōs eis sōtērian hetoimēn apokalyphthēnai en kairō eschatō
verses.literal: who through faith are shielded by God’s power for the salvation that is ready to be revealed in the last time
verses.literalPt: Que mediante a fé estais guardados na virtude de Deus para a salvação, já prestes para se revelar no último tempo,

verses.original: ἐν ᾧ ἀγαλλιᾶσθε ὀλίγον ἄρτι εἰ δέον ἐστὶν λυπηθέντες ἐν ποικίλοις πειρασμοῖς
verses.transliteration: en hō agalliasthe oligon arti ei deon estin lypēthentes en poikilois peirasmois
verses.literal: In this you greatly rejoice though now for a little while you may have had to suffer grief in various trials
verses.literalPt: Em que vós grandemente vos alegrais, ainda que agora importa, sendo necessário, que estejais por um pouco contristados com várias tentações,

verses.original: ἵνα τὸ δοκίμιον ὑμῶν τῆς πίστεως πολυτιμότερον χρυσίου τοῦ ἀπολλυμένου διὰ πυρὸς δὲ δοκιμαζομένου εὑρεθῇ εἰς ἔπαινον καὶ δόξαν καὶ τιμὴν ἐν ἀποκαλύψει Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ
verses.transliteration: hina to dokimion hymōn tēs pisteōs polytimoteron chrysiou tou apollymenou dia pyros de dokimazomenou heurethē eis epainon kai doxan kai timēn en apokalypsei Iēsou Christou
verses.literal: so that the proven character of your faith more precious than gold which perishes even though refined by fire may result in . . . praise glory and honor at the revelation of Jesus Christ
verses.literalPt: Para que a prova da vossa fé, muito mais preciosa do que o ouro que perece e é provado pelo fogo, se ache em louvor, e honra, e glória, na revelação de Jesus Cristo;

verses.original: ὃν οὐκ ἰδόντες ἀγαπᾶτε εἰς ὃν ἄρτι μὴ ὁρῶντες πιστεύοντες δὲ ἀγαλλιᾶσθε χαρᾷ ἀνεκλαλήτῳ καὶ δεδοξασμένῃ
verses.transliteration: hon ouk idontes agapate eis hon arti mē horōntes pisteuontes de agalliasthe chara aneklalētō kai dedoxasmenē
verses.literal: Though you have not seen Him you love Him and though you do not see Him now you believe in Him and rejoice with an inexpressible and glorious joy
verses.literalPt: Ao qual, não o havendo visto, amais; no qual, não o vendo agora, mas crendo, vos alegrais com gozo inefável e glorioso;

verses.original: κομιζόμενοι τὸ τέλος τῆς πίστεως ὑμῶν σωτηρίαν ψυχῶν
verses.transliteration: komizomenoi to telos tēs pisteōs hymōn sōtērian psychōn
verses.literal: now that you are receiving the goal of your faith the salvation of your souls
verses.literalPt: Alcançando o fim da vossa fé, a salvação das vossas almas.

verses.original: Περὶ ἧς σωτηρίας ἐξεζήτησαν καὶ ἐξηραύνησαν προφῆται οἱ περὶ τῆς εἰς ὑμᾶς χάριτος προφητεύσαντες
verses.transliteration: Peri hēs sōtērias exezētēsan kai exēraunēsan prophētai hoi peri tēs eis hymas charitos prophēteusantes
verses.literal: Concerning this salvation the prophets who foretold . . . the grace to come to you searched and investigated carefully
verses.literalPt: Da qual salvação inquiriram e trataram diligentemente os profetas que profetizaram da graça que vos foi dada,

verses.original: ἐραυνῶντες εἰς τίνα ἢ ποῖον καιρὸν ἐδήλου τὸ ἐν αὐτοῖς Πνεῦμα Χριστοῦ προμαρτυρόμενον τὰ εἰς Χριστὸν παθήματα καὶ τὰς μετὰ ταῦτα δόξας
verses.transliteration: eraunōntes eis tina ē poion kairon edēlou to en autois Pneuma Christou promartyromenon ta eis Christon pathēmata kai tas meta tauta doxas
verses.literal: trying to determine . . . the time and setting . . . . . . . . . to which the Spirit of Christ in them was pointing when He predicted the sufferings of Christ and the glories to follow
verses.literalPt: Indagando que tempo ou que ocasião de tempo o Espírito de Cristo, que estava neles, indicava, anteriormente testificando os sofrimentos que a Cristo haviam de vir, e a glória que se lhes havia de seguir.

verses.original: οἷς ἀπεκαλύφθη ὅτι οὐχ ἑαυτοῖς ὑμῖν δὲ διηκόνουν αὐτά ἃ νῦν ἀνηγγέλη ὑμῖν διὰ τῶν εὐαγγελισαμένων ὑμᾶς ἐν Πνεύματι Ἁγίῳ ἀποσταλέντι ἀπ’ οὐρανοῦ εἰς ἃ ἐπιθυμοῦσιν ἄγγελοι παρακύψαι
verses.transliteration: hois apekalyphthē hoti ouch heautois hymin de diēkonoun auta ha nyn anēngelē hymin dia tōn euangelisamenōn hymas en Pneumati Hagiō apostalenti ap’ ouranou eis ha epithymousin angeloi parakypsai
verses.literal: It was revealed to them that they were not serving themselves but you when they foretold the things now announced by those who preached the gospel to you by the Holy Spirit sent from heaven Even angels long to look into these things
verses.literalPt: Aos quais foi revelado que, não para si mesmos, mas para nós, eles ministravam estas coisas que agora vos foram anunciadas por aqueles que, pelo Espírito Santo enviado do céu, vos pregaram o evangelho; para as quais coisas os anjos desejam bem atentar.

verses.original: Διὸ ἀναζωσάμενοι τὰς ὀσφύας τῆς διανοίας ὑμῶν νήφοντες τελείως ἐλπίσατε ἐπὶ τὴν φερομένην ὑμῖν χάριν ἐν ἀποκαλύψει Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ
verses.transliteration: Dio anazōsamenoi tas osphyas tēs dianoias hymōn nēphontes teleiōs elpisate epi tēn pheromenēn hymin charin en apokalypsei Iēsou Christou
verses.literal: Therefore prepare . . . . . . . . . your minds for action Be sober-minded Set your hope fully on the grace to be given you at the revelation of Jesus Christ
verses.literalPt: Portanto, cingindo os lombos do vosso entendimento, sede sóbrios, e esperai inteiramente na graça que se vos ofereceu na revelação de Jesus Cristo;

verses.original: ὡς τέκνα ὑπακοῆς μὴ συσχηματιζόμενοι ταῖς πρότερον ἐν τῇ ἀγνοίᾳ ὑμῶν ἐπιθυμίαις
verses.transliteration: hōs tekna hypakoēs mē syschēmatizomenoi tais proteron en tē agnoia hymōn epithymiais
verses.literal: As obedient children do not conform to the passions of your former ignorance
verses.literalPt: Como filhos obedientes, não vos conformando com as concupiscências que antes havia em vossa ignorância;

verses.original: ἀλλὰ κατὰ τὸν καλέσαντα ὑμᾶς ἅγιον καὶ αὐτοὶ ἅγιοι ἐν πάσῃ ἀναστροφῇ γενήθητε
verses.transliteration: alla kata ton kalesanta hymas hagion kai autoi hagioi en pasē anastrophē genēthēte
verses.literal: But just as He who called you is holy so be holy in all you do
verses.literalPt: Mas, como é santo aquele que vos chamou, sede vós também santos em toda a vossa maneira de viver;

verses.original: διότι γέγραπται ὅτι Ἅγιοι ἔσεσθε ὅτι ἐγὼ ἅγιος εἰμι
verses.transliteration: dioti gegraptai hoti Hagioi esesthe hoti egō hagios eimi
verses.literal: for it is written Be holy because I am holy
verses.literalPt: Porquanto está escrito: Sede santos, porque eu sou santo.

verses.original: Καὶ εἰ Πατέρα ἐπικαλεῖσθε τὸν ἀπροσωπολήμπτως κρίνοντα κατὰ τὸ ἑκάστου ἔργον ἐν φόβῳ τὸν τῆς παροικίας ὑμῶν χρόνον ἀναστράφητε
verses.transliteration: Kai ei Patera epikaleisthe ton aprosōpolēmptōs krinonta kata to hekastou ergon en phobō ton tēs paroikias hymōn chronon anastraphēte
verses.literal: Since you call on a Father who judges each one’s work impartially conduct yourselves in reverent fear during your stay as foreigners
verses.literalPt: E, se invocais por Pai aquele que, sem acepção de pessoas, julga segundo a obra de cada um, andai em temor, durante o tempo da vossa peregrinação,

verses.original: εἰδότες ὅτι οὐ φθαρτοῖς ἀργυρίῳ ἢ χρυσίῳ ἐλυτρώθητε ἐκ τῆς ματαίας ὑμῶν ἀναστροφῆς πατροπαραδότου
verses.transliteration: eidotes hoti ou phthartois argyriō ē chrysiō elytrōthēte ek tēs mataias hymōn anastrophēs patroparadotou
verses.literal: For you know that it was not with perishable things such as silver or gold that you were redeemed from the empty way of life you inherited from your forefathers
verses.literalPt: Sabendo que não foi com coisas corruptíveis, como prata ou ouro, que fostes resgatados da vossa vã maneira de viver que por tradição recebestes dos vossos pais,

verses.original: ἀλλὰ τιμίῳ αἵματι ὡς ἀμνοῦ ἀμώμου καὶ ἀσπίλου Χριστοῦ
verses.transliteration: alla timiō haimati hōs amnou amōmou kai aspilou Christou
verses.literal: but with the precious blood of Christ a lamb without blemish or spot
verses.literalPt: Mas com o precioso sangue de Cristo, como de um cordeiro imaculado e incontaminado,

verses.original: προεγνωσμένου μὲν πρὸ καταβολῆς κόσμου φανερωθέντος δὲ ἐπ’ ἐσχάτου τῶν χρόνων δι’ ὑμᾶς
verses.transliteration: proegnōsmenou men pro katabolēs kosmou phanerōthentos de ep’ eschatou tōn chronōn di’ hymas
verses.literal: He was known before the foundation of the world but was revealed in the last times for your sake . . .
verses.literalPt: O qual, na verdade, em outro tempo foi conhecido, ainda antes da fundação do mundo, mas manifestado nestes últimos tempos por amor de vós;

verses.original: τοὺς δι’ αὐτοῦ πιστοὺς εἰς Θεὸν τὸν ἐγείραντα αὐτὸν ἐκ νεκρῶν καὶ δόξαν αὐτῷ δόντα ὥστε τὴν πίστιν ὑμῶν καὶ ἐλπίδα εἶναι εἰς Θεόν
verses.transliteration: tous di’ autou pistous eis Theon ton egeiranta auton ek nekrōn kai doxan autō donta hōste tēn pistin hymōn kai elpida einai eis Theon
verses.literal: Through Him you believe in God who raised Him . . . from the dead and glorified Him and so your faith and hope are in God
verses.literalPt: E por ele credes em Deus, que o ressuscitou dentre os mortos, e lhe deu glória, para que a vossa fé e esperança estivessem em Deus;

verses.original: Τὰς ψυχὰς ὑμῶν ἡγνικότες ἐν τῇ ὑπακοῇ τῆς ἀληθείας εἰς φιλαδελφίαν ἀνυπόκριτον ἐκ καθαρᾶς καρδίας ἀλλήλους ἀγαπήσατε ἐκτενῶς
verses.transliteration: Tas psychas hymōn hēgnikotes en tē hypakoē tēs alētheias eis philadelphian anypokriton ek katharas kardias allēlous agapēsate ektenōs
verses.literal: Since you have purified your souls by obedience to the truth so that you have a genuine love for your brothers . . . love one another deeply from a pure heart
verses.literalPt: Purificando as vossas almas pelo Espírito na obediência à verdade, para o amor fraternal, não fingido; amai-vos ardentemente uns aos outros com um coração puro;

verses.original: ἀναγεγεννημένοι οὐκ ἐκ σπορᾶς φθαρτῆς ἀλλὰ ἀφθάρτου διὰ λόγου ζῶντος Θεοῦ καὶ μένοντος
verses.transliteration: anagegennēmenoi ouk ek sporas phthartēs alla aphthartou dia logou zōntos Theou kai menontos
verses.literal: For you have been born again not of perishable seed but of imperishable through the living and enduring word of God
verses.literalPt: Sendo de novo gerados, não de semente corruptível, mas da incorruptível, pela palavra de Deus, viva, e que permanece para sempre.

verses.original: διότι Πᾶσα σὰρξ ὡς χόρτος καὶ πᾶσα δόξα αὐτῆς ὡς ἄνθος χόρτου ἐξηράνθη ὁ χόρτος καὶ τὸ ἄνθος ἐξέπεσεν
verses.transliteration: dioti Pasa sarx hōs chortos kai pasa doxa autēs hōs anthos chortou exēranthē ho chortos kai to anthos exepesen
verses.literal: For All flesh is like grass and all its glory like the flowers of the field the grass withers and the flowers fall
verses.literalPt: Porque Toda a carne é como a erva, E toda a glória do homem como a flor da erva. Secou-se a erva, e caiu a sua flor;

verses.original: τὸ δὲ ῥῆμα Κυρίου μένει εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα Τοῦτο δέ ἐστιν τὸ ῥῆμα τὸ εὐαγγελισθὲν εἰς ὑμᾶς
verses.transliteration: to de rhēma Kyriou menei eis ton aiōna Touto de estin to rhēma to euangelisthen eis hymas
verses.literal: but the word of the Lord stands forever And this is the word that was proclaimed to you
verses.literalPt: Mas a palavra do SENHOR permanece para sempre. E esta é a palavra que entre vós foi evangelizada.
